blocks.text: Troposphere ke oopar stratosphere hai, jo zameen ki surface se 12-50 km oopar hai. Is mein temperature -58 °C se -2 °C tak barhta hai. Sooraj ki ultraviolet (UV) radiations kitni pohnchti hain, is hisab se stratosphere ke teen hisse hain. Oopar wale hisse mein ozone sooraj ki zyada energy wali UV radiations absorb (jazb) karti hai aur toot kar monoatomic oxygen (O, akela atom) aur diatomic oxygen (O₂) ban jati hai:

Darmiyani stratosphere mein UV radiations kam guzarti hain. Yahan monoatomic oxygen aur diatomic oxygen dobara mil kar ozone banati hain. Yeh exothermic reaction (garmi dene wala reaction) hai, aur isi se ozone layer banti hai:
Neeche wale stratosphere tak bohat kam UV radiations pohnchti hain, is liye yahan monoatomic oxygen nahi hoti aur ozone bhi nahi banti.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Stratosphere neeche se nahi, apne andar se garam hoti hai: ozone UV absorb karti hai aur O₂ + O ka dobara milna garmi chhorta hai. Isi liye is layer mein oonchai ke saath temperature barhta hai.
